secrets.name: RESEND_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. Resend API key (resend.com → API Keys) so contact-form messages are emailed to you. Messages are also stored in .data/messages.jsonl either way.

secrets.name: CONTACT_TO_EMAIL
secrets.description: Optional. The inbox that should receive contact-form messages. Used together with RESEND_API_KEY.

secrets.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
secrets.description: Optional. Read-only GitHub token (github.com → Settings → Developer settings → Personal access tokens) to raise the API rate limit for the live project/activity sections. The site works without it.
